return_model: Daily carry plus first-order duration response to official par-yield changes; no convexity, transaction cost, or tradable-index replication.
risk_boundary: Historical simulation is not a forecast or investment recommendation.

uncertainty_and_model_risk.shared_market_shocks: Every portfolio is evaluated on the same dated yield-curve changes; cross-portfolio losses are therefore correlated by construction.
uncertainty_and_model_risk.fat_tails: Historical VaR and ES retain the empirical return tail.
uncertainty_and_model_risk.parameter_instability: Rolling coverage tests and 5/20/60-day block sensitivities expose window and dependence assumptions.
uncertainty_and_model_risk.liquidity_and_costs: No security-level bid-ask spread, financing cost, rebalancing cost, or market-depth model is available; results are pre-cost.
uncertainty_and_model_risk.regime_change: COVID-liquidity, 2022 tightening, and post-tightening periods are reported separately rather than pooled without comment.

reversal_conditions: Coverage or independence tests reject the historical model.
Portfolio instruments have material convexity or basis risk.
Trading costs or liquidity erase the apparent carry advantage.

provenance.citation: U.S. Department of the Treasury. Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates. Accessed 2026-07-27.
